title: Shape Raid Bullet Hell Gameplay Trailer
author: JellySquidGames
selftext:
This is the new trailer for my game, Shape Raid. My original trailer dropped with the release of the game over a year ago, but I have since upgraded the visuals for the game substantially with the help of Claude. I have also added a bunch of new boss fights along with enhancements to old bosses, so I wanted a better trailer to reflect that.

There is a demo available for Shape Raid if anyone wants to try the game. All feedback is appreciated!

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148360/Shape\_Raid/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148360/Shape_Raid/)
